title: Where two rail-maintenance manifests differ

blocks.text: A railway's maintenance planner reruns each night's plan and compares manifests. When two differ, the on-call engineer needs to see exactly where. A manifest is nested dicts and lists, for example `{"result": {"objective": 41.0, "plan": [["S1", 3], ["S4", 1]]}}`.
Write `diff_paths(a, b)`. It returns the sorted list of every path at which the two differ:

items: dict keys are joined with dots: `"result.objective"`;
a key present in only one of the two is a difference at that key's path;
two lists of the same length are compared item by item, and an item's path ends in its index: `"result.plan[1]"`, or deeper, `"result.plan[1][0]"`;

two lists of different lengths, or two values of different kinds, differ at their own path. The kinds are three: a dict, a list, or a plain value (a string, number, boolean or `None`). A dict against a list, or a list against a string, is a difference of kind.
two plain values are compared with `==`, as the lesson's own diff does, so `41` and `41.0` are equal and give no path.

blocks.text: Equal manifests give `[]`. About fifteen lines.

"""Run executes this file. Change the calls and see what prints. Submit grades."""
import logging

# Turn the logger up, so the `log.debug` lines of your code show under the printed lines.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")

from manifest_diff import diff_paths

run = {"inputs": {"snapshot": "c9d0", "line": "east"},
       "result": {"status": "OPTIMAL", "objective": 58.0, "plan": [["J2", 1], ["J5", 3]]}}
rerun = {"inputs": {"snapshot": "c9d0", "line": "east"},
         "result": {"status": "OPTIMAL", "objective": 57.0, "plan": [["J2", 2], ["J5", 3]], "gap": 0.0}}

print("paths, run vs itself:", diff_paths(run, run))
print("paths, run vs rerun:", diff_paths(run, rerun))
print("paths, plan of three vs two:",
      diff_paths(run, {**run, "result": {**run["result"], "plan": [["J2", 1], ["J5", 3], ["J8", 2]]}}))

cases.says: equal manifests give no paths, and one changed nested value gives its dotted path
a key present in only one manifest is reported, whichever side has it
all differing paths come back, sorted
lists of equal length are compared item by item, with the index in the path
a list where a string was is a difference, but 41 against 41.0 is not

origin.section: It Compares Whole Manifests, Byte for Byte, and Names What Changed

concepts: a difference is reported as every nested path at which two manifests disagree
